title: Hynek delivers a prepared computer to Benowitz
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Hynek delivers a prepared computer to Benowitz, about c. 1980-1981 at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: J. Alan Heinik showed up at Paul's door with a computer, an entirely built alreadymade computer and said, "This will help you with the signals

plain: Greg Bishop, an author who wrote about a man named Paul Bennewitz, tells a story he credits to Bill Moore, a UFO researcher. Bennewitz lived in Albuquerque, New Mexico, near Sandia National Laboratories, a US government research lab, and believed he was picking up strange signals around 1980. According to Bishop, J. Allen Hynek, an astronomer who had advised the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, turned up at Bennewitz's door with a ready-built computer and said, "This will help you with the signals", which, if true, would tie a famous UFO scientist directly to what Bennewitz was chasing.
